name: web-react
summary: Frontend app structure for React/Vite/Vue-style projects with app shell, features, components, services, models, styles, and tests.
dependency_direction: app -> features -> components/services/models/lib. Shared code must not depend on feature internals.

folders.responsibility: App shell, providers, routing integration, top-level layout.
folders.allowed: Provider composition, route registration, global layout.
folders.avoid: Feature business logic and low-level reusable components.

folders.allowed: Feature pages, feature state, feature-specific components.
Generic controls, layout primitives, status states.

folders.responsibility: API clients, data access, browser/platform service wrappers.
folders.allowed: Fetch clients, SDK adapters, persistence wrappers.

folders.responsibility: Shared types, schemas, and domain models.
Small framework utilities with clear ownership.
folders.allowed: Pure helpers used by multiple modules.

folders.responsibility: Global styles, tokens, and theme integration.
folders.allowed: Global CSS, design tokens, theme variables.
folders.avoid: Feature-specific CSS unless project conventions require it.
Replacing runnable tests with screenshots only.

rules: Preserve the existing framework, design system, and component conventions. For greenfield choices, use semantic HTML and accessible, maintainable styling that fits the product.
Preserve existing typography; choose a system or web font according to product identity, performance, licensing, and accessibility.
Reuse existing design system and component conventions first.
Keep API/data access out of components when the project size justifies separation.
If the project already uses a CSS framework such as Tailwind, follow the existing convention; if it does not, add one only for a demonstrated need and with authorization.
Do not create generic helper buckets for unrelated logic.
When visual direction is incomplete, preserve existing tokens or propose a coherent option and label assumptions; do not force a separate structural-baseline phase.
validation: Inspect package scripts before running lint/test/build.
Use browser verification for visible or interactive UI changes.
